hypothesis: The exact Intel AutoRound artifact can build and serve through its pinned non-speculative vLLM consumer on AIBoss without fallback.
falsifier: The pinned consumer cannot build in a public reproducible environment, startup fails, a fallback occurs, or text/image/video routes fail.

decision_rules.accept: Pinned consumer builds and every required AIBoss route passes.
decision_rules.reject: Any built runtime or route gate fails.
decision_rules.futility: Terminate unsupported only when the pinned consumer itself cannot build.
decision_rules.abort: Abort on mutable source, MTP/speculation enablement, OOM, or failed restore.
